text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's New Year's Eve, and the racing world is abuzz with talk on a certain topic.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Did you see Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross's race?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Of course I did! But Super Creek ran great too! She really cut into their showdown!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see what all those high-level Umamusume do in next year's Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: The news is making a huge deal out of it too! They're calling them the Top Three and saying they're the representatives of this generation…

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, but I heard Tamamo Cross might retire from the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I've alway hadda light appetite, but now I'm gettin' fuller even faster. And my legs've been weirdly heavy lately, so I'm takin' a break.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: To be honest with ya, this might be it for me… My body could be tryin' to tell me, "Hey, you're done here."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Welp, that's the life of an athlete. Ya always gotta know when to call it quits, and listen to your body when it comes to what to do next.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I saw that interview online, but I'm definitely gonna miss her if she really decides to retire. She was doing so well too…
Hey, you two!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Aren't you forgetting someone?! Namely, Inari One, the Umamusume who's gonna bring glory to her hometown of Oi!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah, Inari! Win a bunch of G1s next year and make it your year!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: If you beat both Oguri and Creek, you'll be the real GOAT!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You bet! But don't just cheer for me from behind the screen! Come to the racecourse and watch me run live!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'll send you all off in a blaze of Edo wildfire! Watch as I take the world by storm!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The new year comes, bringing along a new era with it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even now, strong Umamusume keep taking the stage, and one can't help but wonder who will be the one to lead the next generation.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer, did you see Tamamo's interview online?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: What a surprise, right? Time really waits for no one.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It just keeps ticking onward… and everything keeps changing.
choice_data_list: But your feelings haven't changed, have they?
But your feelings haven't changed, have they?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Not at all! They're the same as ever.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: In fact, why don't we set our motivation in stone right now with a New Year's resolution?!
choice_data_list: Health comes first! No overtraining this year!
Let's go back to the basics and grow even more!
Time to learn a new skill that'll beat everyone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A-are you still angry with me for secretly solo training before the Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Urgh… I already told you I won't do it again! Please don't look at me like that!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I promise! I'll even swear it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a little bit of chatting and teasing, Sakura Chiyono O and I make our wishes for the new year.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniff. Hm…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, this is the perfect time to break out my Chiyonotes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I wrote down all my strengths and weaknesses you told me about in here.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Do you want to see my weaknesses?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I suppose you already know what they are, though. Hehe…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a little bit of chatting and teasing, Sakura Chiyono O and I make our wishes for the new year.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniff. Hm…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A new skill that can beat everyone? Hm…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hi-yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hwahhh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: H-how was that? I tried putting my all into it like Yaeno…
choice_data_list: I guess it was all right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haha… That's exactly what Yaeno told me when she was teaching me self defense a while back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a little bit of chatting and teasing, Sakura Chiyono O and I make our wishes for the new year.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniff. Hm…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Is that the scent of takoyaki in the air? I can smell the sauce and bonito flakes together…
choice_data_list: Want to check out the food stalls?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?! N-no, it's okay! I'm not hungry, so don't worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: More importantly, let's hurry up and get back. I'm just itching to run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Inhale… Exhale… Inhale…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Creak…

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: …Ardan. Are you secretly doing rehab all on your own again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I'm sorry. I just want to get better.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: I understand, but even if the exercises you're doing are gentle, they won't help you heal any faster.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm… aware of that.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: If you are, then please listen to our advice on how to recover as quickly as possible.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: We serve the Mejiro family. We are your arms, legs, and mind. Don't hesitate to ask us for help.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back from the academy, Sakura Chiyono O suddenly stops in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Nothing! I was just thinking… the hospital where Ardan's being treated is pretty close to here.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Do you think she watched me run? She must've done, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …No. I can't just assume she was watching.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I have to run well enough that she'll have no choice but to notice me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O's motivation sticks with her even after she makes it back to the academy.
